title: A Runway to Dissipation of Angular Momentum via Worldline Quantum Field Theory
abstract: Extends the worldline quantum field theory (WQFT) formalism to include a direct diagrammatic method of computing the total flux of angular momentum radiated from a black hole scattering event in the post-Minkowskian regime. Provides new WQFT diagrammatic rules for angular momentum dissipation applicable to spinning binary black hole scattering.
key_claims: First direct WQFT diagrammatic method for total angular momentum flux in black hole scattering
Extends WQFT formalism to spinning bodies in post-Minkowskian regime
Provides new Feynman rules within the worldline QFT framework
supports_or_contradicts: NEUTRAL — tangentially relevant to worldline formalism literature (HYP-003/007); gravitational wave physics context only, no direct bearing on holographic force or MERA results.
